meta.name: hunt-subdomain
meta.description: Hunting skill for subdomain takeover vulnerabilities. Includes modern provider fingerprints — Microsoft Azure DevOps `cloudapp.azure.com` regional-pool re-issue (1-click OAuth ATO via wildcard `reply_to`, Binary Security), Zendesk help-desk takeover → email interception → password reset chain (0xprial writeup), Vercel `cname.vercel-dns.com` deleted-project takeover, plus general Fastly CDN service re-attach and S3 dangling-bucket cookie-scope techniques. Use when hunting subdomain takeover — emphasis on ATO-chain primitives (OAuth `redirect_uri`, cookie-domain, email DNS).

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你寻找子域名接管漏洞。它会检查DNS记录、HTTP响应和错误页面，判断哪些子域名可以被攻击者注册并控制。
howto.when: 当你要求进行子域名接管漏洞挖掘，或提到相关关键词（如“子域名接管”、“CNAME”、“NXDOMAIN”）时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you find subdomain takeover vulnerabilities. It checks DNS records, HTTP responses, and error pages to determine which subdomains can be claimed and controlled by an attacker.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to hunt for subdomain takeover vulnerabilities or mention related keywords such as 'subdomain takeover', 'CNAME', or 'NXDOMAIN'.

say_en.text: Check target.com for subdomain takeover risks.
say_en.note: Claude will enumerate subdomains and analyze DNS and HTTP responses.
